content: Petili jubii ku Yelusalemu
Atumi baka Yesu na bandu bangi ba bunhobale Sapanga buku Yudea bajogwa kupwaga bandu banga ayaudi babi bilijetaki lilobi laka Sapanga.
Henu, Petili pajabuja kuhuma ku Yelusalemu, banafunzi biki Yaudi baapala bandu banga ayaudi asekula jandu, batenda kunndosa koni baka pwaga,
“Weapa gupiti mu nyumba ya bandu banga kuseku jandu hadi gukuliki nabu posu pamu!”
Ndi Petili jatumbulya kulandi mbolimboli majambu gagapitii kola tumbuka puutumbuli.

“Lisoba limu panabi ndenda kuloba ku musi guku Yopa, nabi ngati ndei kuinduka ndi nabona hindu kuhuma kwaka Sapanga, nabona sindu ngati shuka ngolongu bikijihulua kuhuma kunani koni bijikamwi kona yoka nsesi, nukubeka pulutengu jangu.
Nalingalia nkati sapambipi nabona inyama yeibi na magolu nnsesi, inyama yu mukioli niinyama yeikwaba pai ni ijuni.
Apalapa nijijogwana sauti jakambwagila, ‘Petili jumuka, usinza, ukulaje.’
Lakini nepani napwaga, ‘Ngaela, Bambo, ndaba sindu sokapi kipija au seakaniki kula ngasekiwahiki kujingi mu ndomu jango.’
Sauti jela jajowanika kabee kuhuma kunani, ‘Waikema sindu sokapi kipija sejikihengiki Sapanga kuba kisapi.’
Lijambu heli lahengiki mala patatu, na mwisu we hindu yela yoka yakelabwiki kunani kabee.
Apalapa, bandu atatu bababi baatumiki kuhuma ku Kaisalia bahika ku nyumba jenabia nakatama.
Loho jaka Sapanga jambwagila nyenda nabu bila kujogopa. Bandu sita haba balongana nanepani kabee kujenda ku Kaisalia na kola twajingala kunyumba jaka Kolinelio.
Jombi jutulandi hejwabi ambweni mtumi jukunani jujemiki kunyumba jaki nukumpwagi. ‘Ntuma mundu ku Yopa jukunkema mundu jumu jobunkema Simoni, liina lengi Petili.
Jombi jakupwagila malobi ga gagujangatya kugombolewa.’
Naenatumbulya kulonge pee, Loho jaka Sapanga jaahulukya ngati hejutuhulukya twepani.
Ndi nakombuka malobi gajwapwaga Bambu, ‘Yohana jabatisa kwa masi, ila mwanganya mwibatiswa kwa Loho jaka Sapanga.’
Henu, ana Sapanga jwaapeki kabee bandu bukuhuma ku ndema jengi nhupi ajelaje jejutupekya na twepani patunhobalya Bambu Yesu Kilisitu, boo, nena na nyane mbaka nenga kumpenga Sapanga?”
Pabajogwana gala, batulia nukundumbali Sapanga koni bakapwaga, “Sapanga jwaapeki bandu banga Ayaudi napwasi juku lekakewa mahakau ili apata womi!”
Kutumbuka kwa bandu babuhobale Sapanga buku Antiokia
Ndaba jamang'aliku gagapitila pabunkoma Sitivini, abole batenda kupalaganyika. Bangi bajenda mbaka ku Foinike, ku Kupulo nuku Antiokia koni bakalandila lijambu la sapi kwaka Ayaudi pena.
Lakini Ayaudi bangi babahuma ku Kupulo nuku Kilene, bajenda ku Antiokia nukulandi Lijambu la Amboni laka Bambu Yesu lela, kwa bandu buku ndema jengi.
Makili gaka Bambu gabii pamu nabombi bandu bingi bahobali nukunng'anambuki Bambu.
Lijambu heli lajogwanika mbaka kwa bandu ba bunhobale Sapanga buku Yelusalemu. Ndi buntuma Balunaba kujenda ku Antiokia.
Pajwahika kola nukubona Sapanga hejapengali bandu, jwatoguli na kwaaloba aendalia kujongana na Bambu kwa mioju jabu joka.
Balunaba jwabi mundu jojutweli Loho jaka Sapanga na jojunhobale Sapanga. Nabandu bingi bajonzukika kwaka Bambu.
Ndienu, Balunaba jwajenda ku Taliso kumpwata Sauli.

Paampata, anndeta ku Antiokia. Boti abeli batama kola nabandu baka Sapanga kwa saka soka koni abola likundi likolongu la bandu. Ku Antiokia kola ndi kobatumbulya kwakema banafunzi baka Yesu, akilisitu.
Kipindi aselasela, Alota baka Sapanga bangi bahika ku Antiokia kuhuma ku Yelusalemu.
Henu, jumu katijabu jobunkema Agabo jwajema, nukupete makili gaka Loho jaka Sapanga jalotila kwibia niinzala ngolongu mu ndema joti. Inzala heji japiti Kilaudio pa jabii bambu nkolongu.
Banafunzi bala baamua kila jumu kulengana nuuwesu waki jupelika sokapi ili kwaajangati bandu bababi atama ku Yudea bala.
Henu, Batenda ahelahe nakaapeke Balunaba na Sauli nsangu gola buhupelika beni kwaka aseja babandu ba bunhobale Sapanga.
